data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
rule_files:
  - '/etc/pilot/alerts.yml'
  - '/etc/proofs/*.yml'
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: pilot
    scheme: https
    authorization:
      credentials_file: /etc/host/token
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/host/ca.crt
    scrape_timeout: 5s
    sample_limit: 5000
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.0.2.2:9810']
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['prometheus:9090']
  - job_name: loki
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['loki:3100']
  - job_name: alloy
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alloy:12345']
  - job_name: pilot-http
    sample_limit: 100
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['pilot-http.pilot-app.svc:8080']
  - job_name: volume-metrics
    metric_relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__name__, namespace]
        regex: 'kubelet_volume_stats_.*;pilot-monitoring'
        action: keep
    scheme: https
    metrics_path: /metrics
    authorization:
      credentials_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.0.2.15:10250']
  - job_name: grafana
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['grafana:3000']
  - job_name: alertmanager
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['alertmanager:9093']

data.loki.yml:
auth_enabled: false
server:
  log_level: warn
  http_listen_address: 0.0.0.0
  http_listen_port: 3100
  grpc_listen_address: 127.0.0.1
  grpc_listen_port: 9096
common:
  instance_addr: 127.0.0.1
  path_prefix: '/data'
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: '/data/chunks'
      rules_directory: '/data/rules'
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory
schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2024-01-01
      store: tsdb
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h
compactor:
  working_directory: '/data/compactor'
  retention_enabled: true
  delete_request_store: filesystem
  retention_delete_delay: 1h
limits_config:
  retention_period: 48h
  ingestion_rate_mb: 1
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: 2
  max_global_streams_per_user: 200
  max_line_size: 4096
  max_query_parallelism: 2
  split_queries_by_interval: 1h
  max_query_lookback: 48h
  reject_old_samples: true
  reject_old_samples_max_age: 48h
querier:
  max_concurrent: 1
query_range:
  cache_results: false
analytics:
  reporting_enabled: false

data.datasources.yml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Pilot Prometheus
    uid: pilot-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
    editable: false
  - name: Pilot Loki
    uid: pilot-loki
    type: loki
    access: proxy
    url: http://loki:3100
    editable: false
data.dashboards.yml:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: pilot
    type: file
    orgId: 1
    disableDeletion: true
    editable: false
    options:
      path: /etc/pilot

data.alertmanager.yml:
global:
  resolve_timeout: 1m
route:
  receiver: local
  group_by: [alertname]
  group_wait: 1s
  group_interval: 5s
  repeat_interval: 4h
receivers:
  - name: local
    webhook_configs:
      - url: https://10.0.2.2:9810/alerts
        send_resolved: true
        http_config:
          authorization:
            credentials_file: /etc/host/token
          tls_config:
            ca_file: /etc/host/ca.crt
